caption: popcap's fuse puzzle - rotate falling pieces to light the fuses from rocket to wizard.
about: Rocket mania is the best puzzle design popcap never rereleased: fuses fall like tetrominoes, and you rotate them so a lit fuse travels from the match on the left edge to the rockets waiting on the right. Multi-rocket chains erupt into fireworks and bonus levels, and the fuse-routing logic underneath is honest pathfinding under time pressure. It sits somewhere between tetris and pipe dreams and beats both at their own game.
The deluxe pc build is pre-merger popcap stock that never reached the current stores, so the archive route keeps the fuses lit.
